name: LX Family
description: LX Family is a private, self-hosted Family OS for calendars, chores, shopping, meals, chat, reminders and shared family files.

notes.text: Open http://<LXC-IP>:3001 and create the first family in LX Family onboarding. Further public registration is protected by default.
This Helper Script uses a native Node.js service inside an unprivileged Debian LXC. It intentionally does not install Docker, Nextcloud or other optional integrations.
Family data and local database backups live in /opt/lx-family/data and /opt/lx-family/backups. Include both paths in your Proxmox backup plan.
